title: Chinese Sylveon Reel

scenes.vo: Sylveon yang satu ini nggak akan pernah kamu pull di versi Inggris, Jepang, bahkan Indonesia.
scenes.caption: This Sylveon? You'll never pull it in English, Japanese, or even Indonesian.

scenes.vo: Juni 2026 lalu, Pokémon merilis Terastal Gathering — eksklusif untuk Pokémon TCG bahasa China Simplified.
scenes.caption: In June 2026, Pokémon released Terastal Gathering — only in Simplified Chinese.

scenes.vo: Isinya mirip Prismatic Evolutions — semua Eeveelution ex ada di sini.
scenes.caption: It's a lot like Prismatic Evolutions — every Eeveelution ex is here.

scenes.heading: SAME ART
scenes.vo: Bahkan Sylveon SAR karya Cona Nitanda yang sudah dikenal kolektor juga ada.
scenes.caption: Even the Sylveon SAR collectors already know, by Cona Nitanda, is in it.

scenes.vo: Tapi ada satu kejutan: nomor 234. Artwork baru, yang nggak dicetak di bahasa lain mana pun.
scenes.caption: But here's the surprise: #234. Brand-new art, printed in no other language.

scenes.heading: ALL BY rika
scenes.vo: …ilustrator di balik Dragonair dari 151 dan Mantyke dari Paradox Rift.
scenes.caption: …the illustrator behind Dragonair from 151 and Mantyke from Paradox Rift.

scenes.title: PSA POPULATION
scenes.source: PSA Population Report · as of 21 Oct 2026

lines: PSA Population Report · as of 21 Oct 2026

scenes.vo: Sejauh ini PSA baru menilai 2.050 kopi — dan cuma 1.596 yang dapat PSA 10.
scenes.caption: PSA has graded 2,050 so far — and only 1,596 of them are PSA 10s.

scenes.vo: Satu-satunya cara dapetin Sylveon ini? Buka pack Terastal Gathering — booster box-nya ready di Kard Avenue.
scenes.caption: The only way to get one? Open a pack. Boxes are in stock at Kard Avenue.

scenes.vo: Download Kard Avenue sekarang di Google Play dan App Store.
scenes.caption: Download the Kard Avenue app on Google Play and the App Store.
